This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Chalula was surrendered into care as a stray, so his past behavior in a home environment is unknown. Chalula has been highly fearful during his stay in care and is not acclimating well to the shelter enviornment. He has allowed only minimal handling since intake. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
